# Agent logins: saved login files per user, Settings → Agents API keys in terminals and runs ## What to build Each user logs in to a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen) once, whatever way that agent logs in. Two mechanisms, both per user: 1. **Login files.** When a repo session ends, the agents' login files are read from the session host's home (`host.loginFiles("get", providers)`) and saved into the user's store; when a new session is prepared, the saved files are written into the new host (`host.loginFiles("put", providers, files)`). The file lists are the existing per-provider table `LOGIN_FILES` in `sandbox-run.ts`. In local mode `LocalWorkspaceHost.loginFiles` is a no-op (the user's own home is used), so this matters for container hosts. 2. **API keys.** **Settings → Agents** lets a user save one value per variable named in `LOGIN_KEYS` (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`). Saved keys are added to the environment of that user's new terminals and of the runs they start (plain, sandboxed and resumed). A key wins over saved login files: files of a provider with a saved key are not written into new hosts. Values are never sent back to the browser. Server plus one additive Settings section in the web UI. `packages/graph-execution` (the engine) must not change. ## Before you start: what dependency tasks already built These exist now; read them first. If a detail differs from what is written here, follow the code. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sessions/sessions.ts`: `SessionManager` with `addHooks(h: SessionHooks)`, where `SessionHooks = { afterPrepare?(p: { user; session; host }): Promise; beforeRelease?(p: { user; session; host }): Promise; terminalEnv?(user): Promise> }`. `afterPrepare` runs right after `host.prepare` for a new session; `beforeRelease` right before `provisioner.release` when a session ends; `terminalEnv` is merged into every session terminal's env. Hook errors are logged and do not stop the flow. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts`: exported `openTerminal(ctx, user, p)` used by `POST /api/terminals` and by sessions; `AppContext.sessions`, `AppContext.provisioner`; `BuildAppOptions.provisioner`, `BuildAppOptions.onContext` in `app.ts`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/host/types.ts` `WorkspaceHost.loginFiles(op: "get" | "put", providers: string[], files?: Record): Promise>` — `{ relPathUnderHome: base64 }`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`: `Store.forUser(user)` → `UserStore { get(); update(fn) }`, zod `dataSchema`; `req.user` from `identity.ts`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sessions/sessions.test.ts` — test setup to copy (fake forge, login, `onContext`, GitHub token `gh-good`, a session on `octo/hello`), and how a second account logs in. - Engine starts go through `host.startEngine({ workspaceId, args, env, timeoutMs })`; the env is still built by `engineEnv(ctx, runId)` in `routes/runs.ts` (old lines 76–85) and `startResume` in `routes/resume.ts` (old lines 99–107). Read their current form. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `docs/prd/hosted-sessions.md` — the "Agent logins" decision row; "Requirements → Sessions" (New sessions bullet: `agentKeys: Record`, only names from `LOGIN_KEYS`); "Requirements → UI" (Settings → Agents bullet); Tests ("Agent keys: a saved `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` reaches a new terminal's environment; a name not in `LOGIN_KEYS` is rejected with 400"). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-run.ts` lines 36–51 (`LOGIN_FILES`, `LOGIN_KEYS`), 88–129 (`loginEntries`: a provider other than `fake` with no file and no key in `env` throws 400), 131–143 (`PASSED`), 153–197 (`sandboxEnv(base, …)`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox.ts` lines 97–114 (`StartParams`), ~606 (`sandboxEnv(process.env, …)`), ~652 (`loginEntries(providers, os.homedir(), process.env)`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (`engineEnv`, the two `ctx.sandboxes.start(...)` calls for project and workspace runs) and `routes/resume.ts` (`startResume` env, the two `sandboxes.start(...)` calls). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.ts` — `GET/PUT /api/settings/sandbox`: the naming and validation style for a settings API. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` (lines 173–198: the page; insert after ``), `pages/SandboxCard.tsx` (lines 1–60: card structure, `api`/`post`, `useToast`, error text), `pages/Settings.css` (lines 9–12: `.settings-card`, `.settings-card-head`), `src/web/Settings.test.tsx` (lines 1–60: the URL-based fetch mock), `src/web/ui/Dialog.tsx` (`ConfirmDialog`). ## Patterns to follow **Settings route style** (mirror `routes/sandbox.ts`): zod body, 400 `{ error }` on bad input, 204 on PUT/DELETE without a body. **Never return secrets** (mirror `routes/forges.ts` lines 26–35: only `tokenEnd`, never the token). Here: only `saved: boolean`. **Web card** (mirror `SandboxCard.tsx`): ```tsx

Agents

...
``` ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** (add to `dataSchema`, do not rewrite it): ```ts /** Settings → Agents: API keys by variable name (only names in LOGIN_KEYS). Never returned by the API. */ agentKeys: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).default({}), /** The agents' login files saved when a session ended: `{ relPathUnderHome: base64 }`. */ agentLogins: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).default({}), ``` ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sessions/logins.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `export const LOGIN_PROVIDERS = Object.keys(LOGIN_FILES).filter((p) => p !== "fake")`. - `export function agentKeyNames(): Array<{ name: string; providers: string[] }>` — every distinct name in `LOGIN_KEYS` (first-seen order: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`) with the providers that use it. - `export async function agentKeyEnv(store: Store, user: User): Promise>` — the user's saved keys, non-empty values only, names filtered by `agentKeyNames()`. - `export function providerOf(rel: string): string | undefined` — the provider whose `LOGIN_FILES` entry equals `rel`, or is a folder entry (trailing `/`) that `rel` starts with. - `export function registerLoginHooks(sessions: SessionManager, store: Store, log?)` adding: - `afterPrepare`: saved = `agentLogins`; drop entries whose provider has a saved key in `agentKeys` (any of its `LOGIN_KEYS`); if anything is left, `await host.loginFiles("put", , files)`. - `beforeRelease`: `got = await host.loginFiles("get", LOGIN_PROVIDERS)`; keep only paths with a known `providerOf`, each at most 256 KiB decoded, 2 MiB in total (log and skip beyond); if not empty, merge into `agentLogins` (same path replaced). An empty answer (local host) changes nothing. - `terminalEnv`: `agentKeyEnv(store, user)`. - **IMPORTS**: `LOGIN_FILES`, `LOGIN_KEYS` from `../sandbox-run.js`; `Store` from `../store.js`; `User` from `../identity.js`; `SessionManager` from `./sessions.js`. - **UPDATE** `app.ts`: `registerLoginHooks(ctx.sessions, ctx.store)` after the session manager is created. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/agent-keys.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** and register in `app.ts`: - `GET /api/settings/agent-keys` → `{ keys: Array<{ name: string; providers: string[]; saved: boolean }> }`. - `PUT /api/settings/agent-keys/:name` `{ value: string }` (trimmed, 1–4096 chars) → 204. A name not in `agentKeyNames()` → 400 `{"error":" is not an agent login key"}` (check the name before the body). - `DELETE /api/settings/agent-keys/:name` → 204 (400 as above for an unknown name). - **GOTCHA**: the value must never appear in a response, a log line or an error message. ### UPDATE terminal and run environments - `routes/terminals.ts` `openTerminal`: merge `await agentKeyEnv(ctx.store, user)` into the terminal `env` (before the agent's own launch env, so `POST /api/terminals` without a session gets keys too). If session terminals already get them from the `terminalEnv` hook, do not add them twice (either way the value is the same). - `routes/runs.ts`: `engineEnv` gets the user (`engineEnv(ctx, runId, keys)`) and adds the keys after the `delete env.GM_PASSWORD` line; both `ctx.sandboxes.start(...)` calls pass `extraEnv: keys`. - `routes/resume.ts`: the same for `startResume`'s env and its two `sandboxes.start(...)` calls. - `sandbox.ts`: `StartParams.extraEnv?: Record`; use `{ ...process.env, ...p.extraEnv }` as the base of `sandboxEnv(...)` and as the `env` of `loginEntries(...)`, so a saved key both reaches the container (all three names are in `PASSED`) and satisfies the "no login" check. - **GOTCHA**: keys are added only for the requesting user; never put them into `TerminalManager`'s shared base env. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/AgentKeysCard.tsx` and UPDATE `pages/Settings.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: a card "Agents" with the hint "API keys log agents in without a browser login. Saved for your account only; a key wins over a saved login." One row per key from `GET /api/settings/agent-keys`: label = the variable name, sub-label "Used by Claude Code, OpenCode" (map provider ids to labels: claude → Claude Code, codex → Codex, opencode → OpenCode, qwen → Qwen Code), a `type="password"` input `autoComplete="off"` with `aria-label={name}`, a **Save** button (`PUT`, then clear the input, toast "Saved "). When `saved`, show a "saved" badge and a **Remove** button that asks with `ConfirmDialog` "Remove ?" and sends `DELETE` (toast "Removed "). A failed request shows the server's error in the row. A failed initial load shows "Couldn't load the agent keys." Render it in `Settings.tsx` right after `` (additive: another task adds an Account section to the same page). - **GOTCHA**: `Settings.test.tsx` mocks `fetch` by URL; add `/api/settings/agent-keys` there if its fallback breaks, and keep the existing assertions unchanged. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `GET /api/settings/agent-keys` → `{ keys: [{ name: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", providers: ["claude", "opencode"], saved: false }, { name: "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN", providers: ["claude"], saved: false }, { name: "OPENAI_API_KEY", providers: ["codex", "opencode", "qwen"], saved: false }] }`. - [ ] `PUT /api/settings/agent-keys/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY { value: "sk-test" }` → 204; then `saved: true`; the value appears in no response. `PUT /api/settings/agent-keys/PATH` → 400 `{"error":"PATH is not an agent login key"}`. `DELETE` → 204 and `saved: false`. - [ ] After saving `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-test`, a new terminal (`POST /api/sessions` on `octo/hello`, and plain `POST /api/terminals`) prints `sk-test` for `echo $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; the second account's new terminal does not. - [ ] The engine env of `POST /api/runs/:ws` and resume contains the user's keys; `sandboxes.start` receives `extraEnv` with them. - [ ] With a provisioner whose host fakes `loginFiles` with an in-memory home: closing a session whose home holds `.claude/.credentials.json` saves it in `agentLogins`; the next session's host gets it via `put`; with a saved `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, the claude files are not put; a path outside `LOGIN_FILES` is not saved. - [ ] Settings shows the Agents card; Save, the "saved" badge and Remove work. - [ ] `packages/graph-execution` unchanged; typecheck, lint and tests pass. ## Tests - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sessions/logins.test.ts`: the API (names, 400, never the value), the terminal env (`describe.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")`; read the PTY output over the WebSocket as `routes/terminals.test.ts` does, or check the env passed to the host's `spawnPty` with a wrapping host), per-user isolation, and the login-file round trip with `BuildAppOptions.provisioner` returning a host that delegates everything to the local host except `loginFiles`, which reads/writes a `Map` (setup copied from `sessions/sessions.test.ts`: fake forge `startFakeForge`, token `gh-good`, `onContext`). - `providerOf` / `agentKeyNames` unit tests in the same file. - Extend `routes/runs.test.ts` or `routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts` to assert the user's key reaches `engineEnv` / `extraEnv` (mirror how those tests capture the env or the fake Docker create body). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/AgentKeysCard.test.tsx` (`// @vitest-environment jsdom`, URL-based fetch mock as in `Settings.test.tsx`). ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager -- logins agent-keys AgentKeysCard Settings runs resume sandbox npm test -w graph-manager git diff --stat packages/graph-execution # must print nothing ```
